chapters.label: The long kick, live
chapters.text: Huddersfield, 2018. A City goal kick. Ederson looks up, finds Agüero seventy yards away. The keeper rushes out, Agüero lifts it over. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again. Huddersfield press high, but Agüero is free behind them. His left foot sends it over the press.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: Behind the goal: Agüero checks back and lobs Ben Hamer. One kick did it all.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: look up before you kick. A long pass to a free teammate starts an attack in one touch.
